figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: (a): One failure mode of CMA-MAE. On a flat objective f, solutions θ1 and θ2 fall in the same archive cell based on their measures, resulting in identical discount values from the discount function fA. (b): In our proposed DMS, the discount model provides a smooth discount function that assigns distinct discount values to θ1 and θ2, showing that θ2 has greater archive improvement than θ1 (∆2 > ∆1) and thus providing a stronger signal to guide search. (c): Number of unique cells where solutions sampled by CMA-MAE land in two benchmarks (mean over 20 trials; Sec. 4).

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色表示 fA/DMS，橙色表示第二条诊断序列或强调箭头，黑色表示 objective/θ，灰色表示 cell 与 guide；面板位置、虚线、marker 和数学标注提供冗余编码。

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: Progression of the archive and discount model in DMS in the 2D LP (Sphere) benchmark. The left heatmap shows the archive, while the right heatmap shows the discount model. To plot the discount model, we computed its output at points in a 200 × 200 grid in measure space. The discount model heatmap also shows the dataset DA of points on a given iteration — blue circles indicates points created with solutions from the emitters, and yellow triangles indicate empty points. On Iteration 0, the discount model initializes to output fmin everywhere. On Iteration 250, as the emitters begin to populate the archive, the discount model begins to output higher values in areas that have been explored. However, unexplored areas still maintain low values (shown as dark colors) due to the empty points in the dataset. On further iterations, the discount model outputs higher and higher values as the emitters populate the archive further, until it outputs high values nearly everywhere on Iteration 10000.

figures.label: Figure 11

caption.text: Figure 11: Similar to Fig. 8, this figure shows how the archive and discount model in DMS progress across iterations. However, this time, DMS does not train the discount model with any empty points, i.e., nempty = 0. As a result, the discount model takes on arbitrary values in areas of the measure space that have not been explored yet, as evinced by the high values across the discount model heatmap on Iteration 250 and 10000. Because the discount values are high everywhere, the emitters in DMS mistakenly believe they have explored all areas of the measure space, even though the archive is essentially empty.

tables.reusable_pattern: 先用 omnibus 表确认整体差异，再用方向矩阵拆解 pairwise，并在表下注明统计符号。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 将 distortion 画成 cell collision 和 smooth repair，Figure 2 将 dataset-defined measure 画成 paired images；Table 1/2 给出 performance/cost，Figures 3/4 展开 trajectory，Figures 7/8 连接 spatial archive/discount，Figures 9–11 检验组件和反事实，Figure 12 提供分布解释。
cross_object_system.caption_system: caption 统一以 Figure/Table 编号开头；qualitative/heatmap captions 按对象定义→设置→编码→发现，曲线强调 mean/SEM，统计表强调检验类型。Figures 3/4/9/10 留 domain/marker 给图面，Figures 7/8/11 承担机制说明；“Highlighted lines” 实际指黄色 cell highlight，局部 wording 不精确。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 主表使用 domain→QD/Cov 两层表头；pairwise 表使用 domain→algorithm 旋转头和三块 domain group；hyperparameter 表使用 algorithm block × domain columns。主要对象复用 domain 顺序，代价是旋转字和符号密度。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Algorithm 1/Table 6 定义配置；Table 1/2 提供 quality/cost；Figures 9/10/Table 7 改动 α、n_empty、restart；Figures 8/11 正反展示 empty-point 机制，闭合 method→failure→ablation。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文主表、cost 和逐 domain 限定由 Appendix B trajectories/heatmaps/statistics、C/F 配置实现、D ablations、E distortion theory 补全；trial 语义、DDS 缺失原因和 source asset 边界不能只靠单张表重建。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF 事实字体以 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern math 为主，source plotting style 以 Times New Roman/Computer Modern math 为主，均为 serif；5–7pt archive labels 和复合图缩放后的最小字是主要可读性成本。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: algorithm line figures 固定五色并用 marker 冗余；archive figures 固定 magma 与蓝/黄 point markers；qualitative grids 黑白；ablation default 黄色 highlight。heatmap colors 与 algorithm colors 不应混读，Figures 8/11 依赖 caption 区分层级。

most_reusable_patterns: 机制三联图：离散 failure→连续 repair→可观测 diagnostic。
固定 domain/algorithm 顺序，让 endpoint、trajectory、统计和 ablation 逐对象对齐。
endpoint + trajectory + spatial state：表格、曲线和 heatmap 承担互补粒度。
正反机制对照：Figure 8/11 只改 empty-point 条件，再由 Figure 10 给 aggregate consequence。
配置与主结果绑定：Table 6 加上 ablation 对象中的 default highlight。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：连接 distortion、CMA-MAE collision、DMS repair 和 diagnostic。
Table 1：12 个 domain 的 QD/Coverage 决策面，是后续 curves/statistics/ablation 索引。
Figure 8 + Figure 11：positive progression 与 no-empty counterexample 构成机制闭环。
Figure 7：把 spatial coverage 与 objective value trade-off 变成 archive state。
Figures 3/4：补充收敛速度、平台、SEM 和 Arm/TA/LSI 边界。
failure_patterns: 广泛 outperforms 需要逐 domain 统计限定：Arm coverage、TA MNIST QD、LSI/MAP-Elites 和 QDDM DDS 缺失都会改变 headline。
Figures 3/4/9/10 的多 panel 加表/legend 造成小字号、SEM 和 scientific ticks 读取成本。
Figures 9/10/Table 7 将黄色 cell highlight 称为 highlighted lines。
Tables 4/5 方向符号未定义且无 pairwise effect/p-value，显著方向可追踪但强度不可复核。
Figures 2/5/6 只给正向样例，没有抽样分母、failure cases、held-out control 或独立质量评估。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文用“机制示意→dataset-defined qualitative pairing→全域 endpoint/cost→trajectory 与 spatial archive→组件消融和反例”的 serif、低装饰、稳定色彩语义链路，把 DMS 表示修复主张连接到性能、代价和失败边界。
